title.es: El de la cuenta para Fina
title.en: The One With the Account for Fina

description.es: Marta le dice a Andrés que le ha contado a Begoña lo de su relación con Fina. Dice que iba a incluir a Fina en su testamento como heredera, pero que Pelayo no lo aceptó, y le pregunta si podría abrir una cuenta a su nombre y dejar dinero en ella para Fina. Andrés acepta. Pelayo le dice a Damián que Marta ha sacado dinero del banco para Fina. Marta dice que sacó dinero para Fina, pero que Fina no lo aceptó. Dice que Fina no va detrás de su dinero, que está a su lado porque la quiere.
description.en: Marta tells Andrés that she has told Begoña about her relationship with Fina. She says that she was going to include Fina in her will as an heir, but Pelayo would not accept it and asks whether she could open an account in Andrés's name and leave money in it for Fina. Andrés agrees to this. Pelayo tells Damián that Marta has withdrawn money from the bank for Fina. Marta says that she withdrew money for Fina but that Fina would not accept it. She says that Fina is not after her money, that she is by her side because she loves her.
